core_philosophy.rationale: To prevent semantic drift, structural confusion, and the dilution of data lineage. Names are deterministic, clear indicators of structural location, mechanical execution bounds, or specific script behavior. Corporate abstractions, conversational euphemisms, or loose roleplay definitions are banned from the namespace.

rule.standard: Houses the active codebase execution layers and connecting wires.
Reserved exclusively for Crew Manifest Templates (XML instructions). No executable Python code sits here.
Reserved for stateless, global, mechanical tool functions. Modules here use operational and maritime verbs related to logistics and infrastructure.

rule.name: Agent-Specific Tool Isolation Prefix
rule.requirement: Any python tool module or functional tool block that is strictly coupled to a single agent's core manifest loop must explicitly include that agent's name as a prefix.

rule.name: Banishment of Command Verb Duplication
rule.requirement: The use of the verb 'execute' is strictly prohibited inside any tool function name or script namespace across the entire codebase, unless the function is explicitly performing an operational task related to capital punishment.
rule.rationale: Calling a function already triggers its execution. Adding 'execute_' introduces redundant code smells and clunky syntax patterns.

artifact.requirement: Must be pre-pended to the raw text string of every vectorized chunk to eliminate contamination and guarantee un-degradable data lineage.

term.replaced_by: Specific Crew Member names (e.g. Pegleg, Spyglass)
